rust_summary: a player saved to the world's store (`native_player_save_to_file`).
doc_summary: a player saved to the world's store: `native_player_save_to_file(player, name, directory)` is heard once for each save of a placed player (when they leave or the world closes, when the dedicated server saves everyone, and for an integrated server's owner when the world saves them; LAN guests are not heard on integrated autosaves) after their data is written (NeoForge's `PlayerEvent.SaveToFile`, `PlayerList.save`). `directory` is the world's player directory (`players/data`); write your own file there, named `<uuid>.<suffix>`, never the player's `.dat`. The player may be leaving, so no player's state is swapped in. It cannot change or stop anything. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:native_player_save_to_file@`.
